name: stackscan
description: Look up the technology stack behind any domain, and the company running it.
long_description:
StackScan answers two questions about any website: what it is built with, and who is behind it.

Ask what a site runs and you get its detected technologies with categories and global usage counts. Ask who is behind it and you get the company name, industry, city, country, address and LinkedIn URL. Ask about a technology and you get how many sites run it and where they are. Batch tools take up to 100 domains in a single call.

Every tool is read-only. Nothing here writes to any of your systems.

Lookups draw on your StackScan credit balance. Checking the balance is free, and the server enforces its own per-session spend cap so an assistant cannot loop through your credits unattended.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Create one in the StackScan dashboard under My Account, API Tokens.

tenant_id.title: Workspace ID
tenant_id.description: Your workspace UUID, shown on the same page as the token.

session_lookup_cap.title: Lookups per session
session_lookup_cap.description: Spend cap: the most credit-consuming lookups this connector will make before it stops and asks you to restart it.
